artworks.title: The Dionysus Cup
artworks.description: Exekias' kylix — Dionysus reclining in a vine-masted ship among dolphins — is the Homeric Hymn's Tyrrhenian miracle fixed in coral-red clay.

popCulture.title: Homeric Hymn to Dionysus
popCulture.description: Hymn 7 — the god hired as a passenger, the mast becoming vines, and the pirates leaping as dolphins into the wine-dark sea.

popCulture.title: Dionysus Cup
popCulture.creator: Exekias
popCulture.description: Munich's black-figure masterpiece remains the visual shorthand for the Tyrrhenian metamorphosis.

popCulture.title: Dionysus
popCulture.description: The god who turns captors into dolphins — mercy for the helmsman, vine and terror for the rest.
